topic: Chadar trek on the frozen Zanskar river
hook: Your winter road in Ladakh is a frozen river.
title: Your Winter Road Is a Frozen River
description:
In winter, the Zanskar river in Ladakh freezes over and becomes a walking path. Locals call walking on it the Chadar trek. Part of the Places That Shouldn't Exist series.

#Shorts #Ladakh #Chadar
